executive_summary: The infrastructure shows signs of underutilization and potential single points of failure, particularly with the HTTP service. Immediate action is recommended to mitigate risks.

predicted_failures.description: The server is underutilized, which could lead to hardware failure over time.

root_causes.description: The HTTP service is running on a single server, increasing the risk of failure.

preventive_measures.action: Deploy load balancing and distribute HTTP service across multiple servers.
preventive_measures.rationale: This will reduce the risk of a single point of failure and improve overall system reliability.
